phases.title: Java Foundations
phases.summary: Solid programming underpins everything. Master OOP, collections, streams, and exception handling before touching frameworks.

phases.title: Selenium Mastery
phases.summary: Locators, synchronization, and reliability. Understand not just how, but why tests fail.

phases.title: TestNG + Framework Engineering
phases.summary: Turn scripts into a maintainable, parallel-safe framework with proper structure.

phases.title: API + SQL
phases.summary: Validate systems below the UI. Faster, more stable tests and full-stack verification.

phases.title: CI/CD + DevOps
phases.summary: Run tests continuously and reliably. Maven, Jenkins, Docker, and GitHub Actions.

phases.title: Playwright
phases.summary: A modern automation tool. Learn its model and when it beats — or doesn't beat — Selenium.

phases.title: AI-Assisted Testing
phases.summary: Use AI as an accelerator for test generation, data, and failure analysis — with judgment.

phases.title: LLM Testing
phases.summary: Test software that USES AI: hallucinations, grounding, RAG evaluation, and safety.

phases.title: AI Agents / Agentic QA
phases.summary: Autonomous agents that plan and act. Understand the loop, the risks, and how to test them.

phases.title: SDET Interview Preparation
phases.summary: Consolidate everything into interview-ready answers that demonstrate engineering thinking.
